summary: Source update changes the learner-exit post-state for SNAP sync (model updated). Reference, MC, Trace and Update suites rebuilt; the rebased harness produced four fresh traces that all replay. Bounded model checking found MC-1 (the same non-durable in-memory state survives a TRUNC-mode exit, which the update does not cover) and MC-2 (pre-existing DIFF-window under-report).
validation_limits: All TLC campaigns stopped at their time bound with non-empty queues (LIMITED_COVERAGE); no exhaustive result is claimed.

MC-1 and MC-2 were found only by steered schedules (ACTION_CONSTRAINT subsets of FocusNext, BFS and simulation) and, for MC-1's consequence, a continuation from a reachable final state; unsteered BFS reached depth 28-35, below the 55-89-step witnesses.
MC-1 is a model-checking result with source analysis; real-system reproduction (Part 4) was not run in this task.
Real traces never exercised TRUNC sync, an in-memory COMMIT inside a SNAP/TRUNC window, a DIFF exit after NEWLEADER, crashes or leader quorum loss; these are covered by model checking only.
The V0 schema-v2 probe source was not preserved; the rebased probe derives fields from real objects (last-element comparisons for histories).
specula ci-result is not available in this environment; generated CI reports were not produced.

findings.title: TRUNC-mode learner exit keeps a non-durable in-memory commit; the update's full shutdown covers only SNAP
findings.cause: TRUNC keeps snapshotNeeded=true, so a COMMIT read before NEWLEADER is applied only in memory (Learner.java:555,614,656-665); the update clears the database on learner exit only when syncMode==SNAP (Learner.java:864; ZooKeeperServer.java:803-810).
findings.trigger: A learner reports a record the leader committed but has not applied, gets TRUNC, applies the forwarded COMMIT in memory, and fails before the NEWLEADER snapshot (e.g. I/O error reading NEWLEADER).
findings.consequence: The learner reports a record its disk lacks; the leader answers with an empty DIFF and no snapshot, the learner logs and ACKs later records, and after restart its history has a committed hole.

premises: TRUNC sync applies pre-NEWLEADER COMMITs to the data tree without logging them.
Learner.shutdown requests a full shutdown only for SyncMode.SNAP.
LearnerHandler.syncFollower sends TRUNC to a learner whose last zxid exceeds maxCommittedLog.

findings.title: DIFF learner exiting between NEWLEADER and UPTODATE under-reports its log; a logged record escapes the next epoch
findings.cause: DIFF NEWLEADER logs buffered proposals through a just-started sync processor but updates the data tree only after UPTODATE (Learner.java:751-785); an exit before UPTODATE takes ZooKeeperServer.shutdown(false)'s early return (ZooKeeperServer.java:804-809), so getLastLoggedZxid reports the stale tree.
findings.trigger: A late DIFF joiner receives an outstanding proposal before NEWLEADER, logs it at NEWLEADER, and the leader fails before the joiner processes UPTODATE; the joiner then wins or joins the next election with its lower data-tree zxid.
findings.consequence: The next epoch is built without the record while it stays in the joiner's log below later committed records; after restart the joiner's data tree diverges, and a record committed with its ACK can be missing from the next leader.

premises: DIFF sync logs pre-NEWLEADER proposals at NEWLEADER and applies them only after UPTODATE.
ZooKeeperServer.shutdown returns early for a non-running learner without stopping started processors or fast-forwarding.
